Description  More Info       Cerruti 1881 Pour Femme Eau de Toilette , launched in 1995, offers a seamless transition from day to night, enveloping the wearer in a delicate embrace of fresh air reminiscent of crisp linens. The scent opens with the lively notes of freesia and mimosa, swiftly followed by a heart enriched with jasmine and orange blossom, culminating in a sensual base that features the warmth of sandalwood. This harmonious blend is a testament to the artistry of Cerruti, a prestigious fashion house established in Italy in 1881 by Antonio Cerruti.  Initially known for its luxurious textiles, Cerruti revolutionized men's fashion in 1957 by introducing the first luxury ready-to-wear collection. Building on this legacy, the brand expanded its offerings to fragrance with the launch of its first scent in 1978, and Cerruti 1881 remains a beloved classic in its collection. Eau de Toilette or Eau de Parfum?  While Eau de Toilette contains 5-9% of perfume oil, Eau de Parfum usually contains 8-14%. Eau de Parfums therefore last longer and smell more intense.   Natural or synthetic fragrances?  Perfumes with natural ingredients often smell different in batches based on the source of the ingredients, while synthetic ingredients usually have consistency in their smell and lasts longer. Notes and different smells after application?  Perfumes are often designed with top, middle, and base notes and are designed to smell different based on the time after application. For example, some top-note citrus scents smell stronger immediately upon application, while a lavender middle note may be sensed after some time from application as the top note evaporates.

listings.rawTitle: Lolita Lempicka Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Immerse yourself in enchanting fairy tale moments with each spray.  Experience a unique blend of whimsical and dark notes that evolve beautifully throughout the day.  Long-lasting formula ensures you'll make a lingering impression wherever you go.  Perfect for the modern romantic, embodying both femininity and intrigue.  Beautifully designed bottle adds a touch of elegance to any vanity.    Description  More Info      Lolita Lempicka Eau de Parfum 100ml – The Original Fairy Tale in a Bottle  Step into a world of enchantment with Lolita Lempicka Eau de Parfum, an evocative scent that captures the essence of whimsical tales and forest mysteries. Imagine a forest nymph gracefully weaving poetry amidst mossy glades—this perfume embraces that spirit. It’s not merely a fragrance; it’s an experience . With a nostalgic blend of fairy tale sweetness, deep woods, and a hint of adult mystery, it promises a sensorial journey that is both complicated  and magical .  The perfume opens with a flirtatious burst of star anise and violet, swirling harmoniously with lush ivy. As you delve deeper, a bold and enticing licorice note emerges, balanced beautifully by juicy amarena cherry, rich iris, and velvety orris root, transforming your skin into a canvas of dark romance. It's as though the very essence of a captivating fairy tale is captured in a bottle, enticing you with every spritz.  As Lolita Lempicka settles, it reveals a warm embrace of smooth vanilla, sumptuous praline, and creamy tonka bean, rounded off by earthy vetiver. This transformation is both soft and powerful—innocence mingling with sensuality, like a shy princess with a touch of recklessness, reminiscent of Snow White embracing her wild side.   Projection and Longevity:  Don't underestimate the staying power of this captivating fragrance. Once applied, it lingers delicately throughout the day, whispering its secrets long after the first spray. On well-moisturized skin, it wraps you in an evolving aura, tempting others to draw closer. Whether you want to create a captivating presence or maintain a personal scent cloud, this perfume adapts to your unique vibe.   A Note of Honesty:  Lolita Lempicka isn’t your standard blind buy. Its polarizing scent evokes diverse interpretations. For some, it is nostalgic bliss, while others might detect baby powder or wet soil nuances. If anise or violet isn’t your preference, you may wish to explore other options. However, for those daring enough to embrace its complexity, this scent could very well evolve into your signature fragrance.   Why People Love It:    Flaunts main character energy; perfect for those who dare to stand out.  Uniquely enchanting, setting itself apart from mainstream fragrances.  Versatile layering potential—mix with vanilla or earthy notes for a unique twist.  The stunning violet apple bottle with gold accents makes it a visual masterpiece on any dresser.    Fun Fact:  Released in 1997 by the talented Annick Menardo, Lolita Lempicka was revolutionary for its time and paved the way for many “fairycore” fragrances. While fans treasure the original formulas, this current incarnation retains its enchanting allure, captivating new fans while satisfying loyal devotees.   Notes Breakdown:   🌿 Top Notes:  Star Anise, Violet, Ivy  🍒 Heart Notes:  Licorice, Cherry, Iris, Orris Root, Amaryllis  🍮 Base Notes:  Vanilla, Praline, Tonka Bean, White Musk, Vetiver   Final Thoughts?  Lolita Lempicka represents a captivating adventure—each application tells a different story that evolves with you. It strikes a harmonious balance between comfort and chaos, embodying both innocence and allure. Experience the embrace of a velvet-draped enchantress under the moonlight. Not everyone understands her magic, but for those who do, she can become a cherished scent.      Ingredients:  Alcohol Denat, Water (Aqua), Fragrance (Parfum), Benzyl Salicylate, Hydroxycitronellal, Benzyl Alcohol, Butyl methoxydibenzoylmethane, Geraniol, Hexyl Cinnamal, Linalool, Limonene, Isoeugenol, Benzyl Benzoate, Citral, Tris (tetramethylhydroxypiperidinol) citrate, Ethylhexyl salicylate, Coumarin, Methyl anthranilate, Citronellol, ci 14700, ci 17200, ci 60730, ci 19140. Formulation and ingredients are subject to change by the brand.
